title: Revival on Villa | Music Row Retreat
description:
Welcome to Revival on Villa : a designer retreat in Nashville's Edgehill neighborhood, steps from Music Row and Edgehill Village dining. This beautifully curated, multi-level home features a peacock-mural primary suite with king bed, a tropical powder room, cozy fireplace living room, and a private deck. Two bedrooms, 2.5 baths, free alley parking, and a central location between Vanderbilt, the Gulch, and Broadway. Your Nashville basecamp starts here.

The space
✨ The Design & Layout
This property spans three levels, offering a unique sense of privacy and separation.

• Ground Floor: Enter through the warm, inviting living room featuring a fireplace, a dedicated workspace with a striking green granite desk, and access to the backyard. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into a fully equipped kitchen and dining area. Don't miss the designer powder room tucked behind the stairs, featuring incredible tropical animal wallpaper and a custom green vanity.

• Second Level: Ascend the stairs to find a charming guest bedroom with a queen bed, adorned with green patterned wallpaper and a sliding wood door for privacy. This level also features a full bathroom with an eye-catching orange accent wall and a modern shower.

• Primary Suite (Top Level): The crowning jewel of the home. This expansive upper retreat features a stunning peacock mural, a plush queen bed, and a comfortable pullout couch ("Benny") for flexible sleeping arrangements. You'll also find a mini-fridge, a second workspace, and a private deck overlooking the backyard. The suite is completed by a spacious, bright master bathroom with a double vanity and a unique octagonal window.

Guest access
Important Layout Notes:

• Two Units on Property: Please note there are two separate units on this property. While your indoor space is completely private, the backyard area is shared.

• Stairs Required: This home spans three levels. Both bedrooms are located upstairs (second and third floors) and are only accessible by stairs. There is no elevator. Guests must be comfortable climbing stairs.

• Parking: You will have one dedicated parking spot located conveniently in the rear alley.
